Attack Vector: Release of compromised versions of the Ledger Connect Kit through a taken over npmjs account
Indicators of Compromise: Theft of over $700,000 from users’ wallets

Method of Attack: Exploiting GitHub’s reputation to distribute harmful content
Attack Vector: Combining obfuscation with encryption/decryption methods, employing fileless malware, and leveraging the reputation of a very popular project to enhance credibility and increase the likelihood of downloads

Impacted Systems: Various systems and organizations relying on JetBrains TeamCity
Attack Vector: Exploitation of a critical vulnerability (CVE-2023–42793) by North Korean and Russian threat groups
